name: pager
title: Swipe pager with dots
summary: Three full-width cards swiped horizontally; the strip snaps, animated, to the nearest page and a dot indicator follows.
prompt: Make a horizontal pager of three cards I can swipe between; it should snap to the nearest card and show page dots.
teaches: Track a horizontal swipe in pixels with touchExpression ["touchX()"] (default and max 2 * @w with @w = componentWidth(), min 0, touchMode 1 so it stops where released)
Snap to a page by rounding: page = round((2 * @w - @px) / @w)
Slide to the snapped page with an animated expression {"value": "@w * -@page", "anim": 0.35} and translate the strip of pages by it
Move the active dot with the same animated value (cx = 160 - @shift / 18), so the dot and the strip stay in step

snippets.note: the swipe, in px: dragging left lowers px; it starts at, and is capped by, 2 * @w (page 0), so the range follows the live width
page index: the nearest whole page, in page widths of the live componentWidth()
strip offset, animated over 0.35 s whenever page changes
page 2’s card: the strip is translated by the animated shift, then by one page width (@w) per card
the active dot, derived from the same animated shift: -20 - @shift / @w * 20 around the centred dots

check.describe: Starts on Today with the first dot lit; a 200 px swipe left lands on This week, with the second dot lit. Resized, a page is the live componentWidth() wide and the cards, labels and dots follow the box: at 234×200 a 140 px swipe (over half a page) lands on This week, at 540×260 a 300 px swipe does, with taller cards and the dots still at the bottom.

pitfalls: The Java JSON parser does not read touchSpec, so the notch stop modes (notchesEven and friends) cannot be configured from JSON, and on Android they index an empty spec; snap the displayed value with round() instead
Delta touch modes (0–5) move the value by the drag distance, so a leftward swipe lowers px; start at max (2 * @w = page 0) so swiping left can reach the later pages
Only the display snaps: the touch value keeps the fractional position, so the next swipe starts from where the last one ended rather than from the page boundary
A touchExpression expression element that is an infix formula is compiled separately; keep ["touchX()"] and scale afterwards if you want a release velocity

A pager that hard-codes the page width (360, 720) breaks as soon as the host is narrower or wider: read componentWidth() into a variable and use it for the page width, the touch range (defaultValue and max accept expressions) and the page index
